title: Warm Dutch Beef Skillet
description: A hearty, low-sodium Dutch dish featuring tender beef, sweet onions, and a hint of bonito, perfect for a cozy date night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef strips with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips to the skillet and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the skillet and cook the sliced onions until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle the bonito flakes and brown sugar over the onions and cook for 1 minute.
Add the flour to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the beef broth to the skillet, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Return the beef to the skillet and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 20 minutes, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
